cards.card_text: Laban says he has learned by divination that the LORD has ___ him because of Jacob.
cards.verse_text: I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you.”
cards.snippet: I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you.”

cards.card_text: The steward is also told to say this is the cup his master drinks from and uses for divination, and then, "What you have done is wicked!" He catches up and says it all, just like Joseph told him.
cards.verse_text: Is this not the cup my master drinks from and uses for divination?
cards.snippet: Is this not the cup my master drinks from and uses for divination?

cards.card_text: Then comes a quick run of don'ts: no eating anything with blood still in it, no divination or sorcery, no cutting their bodies for the dead, no tattoo marks, and no cutting the hair at the sides of the head or clipping the edges of the beard.
cards.verse_text: You must not practice divination or sorcery.
cards.snippet: You must not practice divination or sorcery.

cards.card_text: So the elders of Moab and Midian head out with the fees for divination in hand, and they tell Balaam the words of Balak.
cards.verse_text: The elders of Moab and Midian departed with the fees for divination in hand.
cards.snippet: The elders of Moab and Midian departed with the fees for divination in hand.

cards.card_text: That strength is “like a wild ox.” Then Balaam turns to the subject of spells and divination.
cards.verse_text: For there is no spell against Jacob and no divination against Israel.
cards.snippet: For there is no spell against Jacob and no divination against Israel.

cards.card_text: Moses names those ways: sacrificing a son or daughter in the fire, divination, conjury, interpreting omens and sorcery.
cards.verse_text: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire, practices divination or conjury, interprets omens, practices sorcery,
cards.snippet: …among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire, practices divination or conjury, interprets omens, practices sorcery,

cards.card_text: Rebellion is like the sin of divination, he says, and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry.
cards.verse_text: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry.
cards.snippet: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry.

cards.card_text: They sacrifice their sons and daughters in the fire, and they practice divination and soothsaying.
cards.verse_text: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire and practiced divination and soothsaying.
cards.snippet: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire and practiced divination and soothsaying.

cards.card_text: Manasseh practices sorcery and divination, and he consults ___ and spiritists.
cards.verse_text: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced sorcery and divination, and consulted mediums and spiritists.
cards.snippet: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced sorcery and divination, and consulted mediums and spiritists.

cards.card_text: God says there will be no more false visions or flattering divinations within the house of Israel.

cards.card_text: These prophets see false visions and speak lying divinations, then claim, "Thus declares the LORD," when the LORD did not send them.
cards.verse_text: They see false visions and speak lying divinations.
cards.snippet: They see false visions and speak lying divinations.

cards.card_text: Then God asks them, "Haven't you seen a false vision and spoken a lying divination when you proclaim, 'Thus declares the LORD,' even though I have not spoken?"

cards.card_text: God says these women will no longer see false visions or practice divination.
cards.verse_text: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination.
cards.snippet: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination.

cards.card_text: A sword is drawn for slaughter…" And while false visions and lying divinations go around, that sword is headed for the necks of the wicked, whose day has come.
cards.verse_text: A sword is drawn for slaughter, polished to consume, to flash like lightning— while they offer false visions for you and lying divinations about you—to be placed on the necks of the wicked who are slain, whose day has come, the time of their final punishment.

cards.card_text: And her prophets practice divination for money.
cards.verse_text: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets practice divination for money.
cards.snippet: …a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets practice divination for money.

cards.card_text: One day on the way to the place of prayer, they're met by a slave girl with a spirit of divination, and her masters make a large income off her fortune-telling.
cards.verse_text: One day as we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl with a spirit of divination, who earned a large income for her masters by fortune-telling.
